title: Signal Engine ↔ Chart contract (CHARTER §7)
description: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the signal→chart marker contract (research/signal_engine/CHARTER.md §7). The signal engine WRITES these shapes; the charting web-app READS them. Both sides build to THIS file so the two workstreams never drift. Encodes the two §7 shapes via $defs: `perTicker` (the per-ticker chart-marker file site/signals/<TICKER>.json) and `brainLeaf` (the Mastermind brain leaf data/signal_archive/mtf_signals_latest.json). Contract rule: if either side needs a new field, ADD it HERE first, then both sides build to it — never invent a divergent shape in the charting app. No version field yet (v1 implicit).
$comment: This document only defines $defs; it asserts nothing at the root. scripts/validate_signals.py validates each file against the relevant $def (perTicker for site/signals/*.json, brainLeaf for the archive). Keep `quality` enum in sync with engine/signal_quality.py: it emits take | block | pending (pending = last 1-2 bars can't confirm yet) — documented in CHARTER §7.

date.description: ISO calendar date YYYY-MM-DD (a 3D bar date).

state.description: Confluence state of the most recent bar.

type.description: buy=confluence BUY★, sell=confluence SELL★, cut=fast-reversal cut-loss, rebuy=fast-reversal re-entry.

quality.description: Buy-filter verdict — present on buy/rebuy ONLY (never sell/cut). take=passed the validated buy-filter (render solid); block=filtered out (render greyed/hollow); pending=last 1-2 bars cannot confirm reclaim-and-hold yet.

reason.description: Human-readable rationale for the buy/rebuy quality verdict.

allOf.$comment: `quality` and `reason` are buy-filter verdict fields — they may appear ONLY on buy/rebuy markers. Forbid both on sell/cut. (validate_signals.py re-asserts this with a clearer message.)
Every buy/rebuy carries the buy-filter verdict — `quality` is REQUIRED on them (the chart reads it to render solid/hollow/provisional). A bare buy with no quality is a drift the chart can't render.

trail_stop.description: Current 3D EMA8 level (the close-only trailing trend). DISPLAY-ONLY tail-risk context, NOT a mechanical stop — the validated exit stays the oscillator sell/cut. See CHARTER §7.

trail_breach.description: Is the latest close below trail_stop (elevated drawdown risk right now). Display-only risk flag, never an auto-sell.

risk_flags.description: Ascending 3D bar-dates where price freshly breached a RISING EMA8 trailing trend (an uptrend's trail breaking = tail-risk event). DISPLAY-ONLY risk layer, kept OUT of `markers` so it never collides with the one-trade-marker-per-bar rule and is never read as a validated sell. Render de-emphasized (e.g. dotted/⚠).

early_markers.description: Ascending 3D bar-dates of the 2D-MACD pre-cross ADVANCE-WARNING (3D StochRSI bottom-turn while the faster 2D RSI-MACD histogram is only rising). Validated as m2d_s3d_early: fires ~5 trading days BEFORE the confirmed `buy` and ~2% cheaper, but acting on it early is empirically WORSE entry quality (deeper drawdown — see CONFLUENCE_TUNING.md §3/§5b). DISPLAY-ONLY context, kept OUT of `markers`, suppressed on a confirmed-buy bar, NEVER a buy/take, NEVER scored. Render as a faint/hollow pre-dot distinct from the green buy ▲.

early_now.description: Is the latest bar an active 2D-MACD advance-warning. Display-only context, never an auto-buy.

markers.description: Chronological (ascending) chart markers. validate_signals.py asserts strict ascending order.

pit.description: RC-R2 append-only marker-integrity disclosure (engine/marker_integrity.py): cumulative drift counters accrued across nightly recomputes (kept_frozen / refined / appended / drift_lost / drift_deep_new / relabel_blocked), `prev_asof` of the prior vintage, and a `last_night` sub-dict holding the same counters for the latest merge only. Engine-side bookkeeping the chart does NOT read — kept open (additionalProperties true) so new counters never break the contract gate, unlike the chart-facing shapes above.

prev_asof.description: asof of the prior vintage merged against; null on the first-ever write (no prior file).

signalEntry.description: One ticker's compact snapshot inside the brain leaf (§7.B).

trail_stop.description: Current 3D EMA8 trailing-trend level (display-only tail-risk context; see perTicker.trail_stop).

trail_breach.description: Is the latest close below trail_stop (elevated drawdown risk now). Display-only, never an auto-sell.

early_now.description: Is the latest bar an active 2D-MACD pre-cross advance-warning (display-only context; see perTicker.early_markers). NEVER a buy and NEVER scored.

last.description: The ticker's most recent TRADE marker (buy/sell/cut/rebuy), or null when it has no markers. Never a risk_flag — breaches are not trade signals.

brainLeaf.description: Brain leaf — data/signal_archive/mtf_signals_latest.json, loaded into latest["mtf_signals"] by engine/run.py (§7.B). Consumed as a display-only RISK / entry-quality input, NOT alpha.

source.description: Provenance of the per-ticker daily close feeding the 3D bars: daily_adjusted = nightly adjusted daily store (default); intraday_delayed = derived from the 15-min-DELAYED intraday store (--intraday research hook, engine/bar_derive.py). Optional display-only labeling, not alpha.

note.description: Honest-labeling note (display-only risk signal, not alpha).
